impact_assessment.why: The village skyline is static and has no landmark; a windmill adds a recognizable destination, a world feature and continuous animation.
impact_assessment.benefits: A rotating windmill visible from the spawn, a stronger skyline, eight baked blade frames shared by the pixel and GPU builds, and a warm window light at night.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: one new world entity on the deterministic layout; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none; growth: eight poses of roughly 130 faces; placement must stay dry, walkable, off the path and outside the quest route.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Place it via _walkable_near at village (-24,-18), keep the solid radius at 3m, assert both generated worlds contain it at the same coordinates, cap the pose set at eight, and verify the spawn and pixel-village captures.

checkpoints.description: Task 'aldervale-gpu-hud-v1' completed successfully.

[1/2] Add a failing-first compact-layout test and fix the GPU status panel so the gear line clears the HP/STA/XP bars at 11-13px rows; verify in the live /play3d page at a mid-size stage. [2/2] Run the full project gate and commit.

impact_assessment.why: At 11-13px rows the compact GPU HUD draws the gear line through the HP/STA/XP bars; the full >=80px layout was verified but the compact branch was not.
impact_assessment.benefits: A readable HUD at common laptop window sizes without leaving the 5.2-row scrim or falling back to ASCII.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none, drawing-only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none; visual: title, bars, gear and quest must stay inside the 5.2-row panel and clear each other down to the 11px threshold; test: page-string assertions only, so the live capture remains the visual proof.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Derive compact row positions from the panel height, clamp the gear baseline above the bar bottom, pin the geometry in a unit test, and verify at a compact stage plus the existing full stage.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Phase 4 green: 191 tests (92.9s), hygiene, guidelines/map and secrets pass 4/4. Compact GPU HUD fixed: 13px title, 8px bars at y+19 with 9px labels, gear baseline clamped above barBottom, 10px quest line at y+h-5; no collisions at 11-13px rows. Live captures verified 1300x900 compact, 2200x1400 full and 1000x700 ASCII fallback. Added test_webgl_compact_hud_keeps_rows_apart. README and ADR unchanged because the documented compact/full/fallback behaviour is unchanged. checklists: passed; commit follows, no push.
Task 'aldervale-gpu-hud-compact-v1' completed successfully.

[1/3] Failing-first model tests, then rebuild the campfire (ash bed, 8-stone ring, four charred logs with ember tips, four layered flame tongues) and slim the torch flame with an iron basket. [2/3] Add an additive light glow to the WebGL HUD for campfires, torches, shrines and lit windows. [3/3] Update README/ADR, capture day and night scenes, run the 4/4 gate and commit.

impact_assessment.why: The fire props are the coarsest models in the scene: the campfire reads as a solid orange cone and gate torches carry half-metre flames; the GPU scene also has no bloom around its point lights.
impact_assessment.benefits: Readable layered fire silhouettes, warmer and deeper night lighting around fires and windows, and a more believable village at dusk without new assets or dependencies.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none, visual-only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none; performance: up to six radial gradients per HUD frame; visual: glow must stay subtle by day and must not cover the HUD panel, and model bounds must stay inside the atlas spec size/height.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Cap glow radius and alpha, scale alpha by 1-daylight, skip modal states and lights behind the camera, update the atlas spec bounds, pin face/emissive/bounds and page hooks in tests, and verify day, night and small-stage captures.

checkpoints.description: [3/3] Phase 4 green: 194 tests (97.1s), hygiene, guidelines/map and secrets pass 4/4. Rebuilt the campfire (ash bed, eight-stone ring, four charred logs with ember tips, four flame tongues and sparks; bounds 1.5x1.5x0.9) and the torch (pronged iron basket, three stacked flames, max height 2.085m). Added a projected additive light glow for up to six lights, scaled by 1-daylight with flicker and skipped in modals or behind the camera. README and ADR-037 updated. Day (1600x1000) and night (2200x1400) captures verified. checklists: passed; commit follows, no push.
Task 'aldervale-fire-pass-v1' completed successfully.

[1/2] Extend the cottage roof with six thatch rows per slope, a rounded ridge with end caps, eaves fascia and corner brackets, plus a chimney pot; pin the detail with the house mesh test. [2/2] Update README/ADR-038, capture the village, run the 4/4 gate and commit.

impact_assessment.why: Cottages are the dominant village silhouette, but their roofs were smooth slabs with only three ridge strips and no eaves depth.
impact_assessment.benefits: A layered thatch silhouette, deeper eaves and stronger cottage architecture at the same low-poly budget.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none, visual-only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none; growth: 356 to 451 faces per house pose, max height 3.77m under the 4.3m spec; visual: alternating straw tones must not read as a ladder.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Use two close straw tones, keep the ridge radius small, pin face count and ridge height in the test, and verify the village in a live capture.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Phase 4 green: 194 tests (100.3s), hygiene, guidelines/map and secrets pass 4/4. README and ADR-038 updated; a 1600x1000 village capture verified the eaves, brackets and ridge. checklists: passed; commit follows, no push.
Task 'aldervale-roof-pass-v1' completed successfully.

[1/3] Send chimney world positions for every cottage in the WebGL scene payload and add a failing-first payload test. [2/3] Draw drifting smoke puffs in the browser over the new chimney pots, reusing the light projection. [3/3] Update README/ADR-039, capture day and night, run the 4/4 gate and commit.

impact_assessment.why: The cottages now have chimney pots but emit nothing, leaving the village skyline static and the new roof details feeling unfinished.
impact_assessment.benefits: Living chimney smoke that reads by day and night, stronger village atmosphere, and a scene payload other clients can reuse.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: scene JSON gains a smoke list; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none; performance: four projected puffs per house; visual: smoke must stay soft, drift upward and not cover the HUD or look like fog.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Cap puff alpha and radius, fade with rise, project through the shared camera matrix, skip off-screen sources, pin the payload fields and page hooks, and tune from day/night captures.

checkpoints.description: [3/3] Phase 4 green: 195 tests (107.3s), hygiene, guidelines/map and secrets pass 4/4. The WebGL scene now sends a smoke list (x/y/z/phase) for five cottage chimneys derived from variant offsets and yaw; the browser projects each source and drifts four cached 64px puffs 3.6m over a 20s cycle at 0.28 day / 0.34 night alpha, skipped in modals. README and ADR-039 updated; clear-day 1600x1000 and night captures verified the plumes. checklists: passed; commit follows, no push.
Task 'aldervale-smoke-pass-v1' completed successfully.

[1/2] Add a failing-first page test and a metal-aware sheen plus view-facing rim light to the WebGL model shader. [2/2] Update README/ADR-040, capture the daylight village, run the 4/4 gate and commit.

impact_assessment.why: GPU models were lit only by diffuse and point lights, so steel armour looked matte and silhouettes merged into the terrain at night.
impact_assessment.benefits: Steel and gold pick up a sun highlight, plaster and roof edges gain depth, and figures read more clearly against grass and stone.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none, shader-only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none; visual: sheen must stay off foliage and not make plaster look wet; performance: eight extra ALU ops per model fragment.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Gate the sheen with a smoothstep on vertex brightness, cap both terms, scale by sun/daylight, keep the wet specular separate, and verify a daylight capture against the previous frame.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Phase 4 green: 196 tests (129.0s), hygiene, guidelines/map and secrets pass 4/4. The model shader now adds a brightness-gated half-vector sheen and a view-facing rim light, capped and scaled by sun/daylight; steel, gold and roof edges read while foliage stays matte. README and ADR-040 updated; a daylight 1600x1000 capture was compared against the pre-shading frame. checklists: passed; commit follows, no push.
Task 'aldervale-shading-pass-v1' completed successfully.

impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep the new rim inside the existing 2.4m bounds, pin face count and height in the test, and verify the village pixel capture before the gate.
